sections.title: 🎯 What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Choosing the right loop makes your code cleaner and more efficient! Today, you'll master:

• When to use `while`, `do-while`, and `for` loops
• How to pick the best loop for different scenarios
• Common pitfalls to avoid when looping

sections.title: 💡 Concept Explanation
sections.content:
Imagine you're a chef in a kitchen:

• **While loop**: Like checking if you have enough ingredients *before* starting to cook. You keep cooking only if you have what you need.
• **Do-while loop**: Like tasting your dish *after* cooking it once - you always cook at least once!
• **For loop**: Like following a precise recipe with exact steps - perfect when you know how many times to stir.

**When to use which?**

• Use `while` when you don’t know how many times you’ll loop (e.g., reading user input until they say 'quit')
• Use `do-while` when you must run the loop at least once (e.g., showing a menu and asking for choice)
• Use `for` when you know the exact number of iterations (e.g., processing 100 records)

sections.title: ⚡ Key Points
points: ✓ `while`: Check condition first, then loop (0+ times)
✓ `do-while`: Loop first, then check condition (1+ times)
✓ Choose `while` for unknown counts, `for` for known counts
✓ `do-while` is great for menus and input validation

sections.title: 🔥 Tips & Mistakes
dos: Use `for` when you know how many times to loop
Use `while` for loops that might not run at all
Use `do-while` when the loop must run at least once
donts: Don't use `for` when you don't know the loop count
Don't forget to update your loop variable (infinite loops!)
Don't use `do-while` when the first run might be invalid
sections.protip: When in doubt, ask: 'Do I need to run this at least once?' If yes, use `do-while`!

sections.title: 🌍 Real World Use
sections.content: Where is Which Loop to Use? used in real apps?

examples.how: Use `while` for game loops that run until the player quits
Use `do-while` to show menu and process transactions until user exits
Use `for` to process each record in a database table

problem.description:
Write a program that:
1. Asks the user to guess a number between 1-10
2. Keeps asking until they guess correctly (the number is 7)
3. Counts how many guesses they took

Which loop would be best for this?
hints: You don't know how many guesses it will take
You need to check the guess before looping
Remember to increment the attempts counter
problem.explanation:
We used a `do-while` loop because:
1. We need to ask at least once
2. We don't know how many guesses it will take
3. We check the condition after each guess
